name: On Door Concepts Ltd.
summary: On Door Concepts Ltd. operates as an omni-channel retailer specializing in household and consumer products, primarily within the retail and internet retail industry. The company retails a wide range of groceries, food staples, fresh produce, dairy, home care products, and personal care items. It employs a business model that combines physical neighborhood convenience stores with an integrated e-commerce platform and mobile application for home delivery services. On Door Concepts Ltd. primarily targets the mid-market urban consumer segment in high-density residential areas, with a significant operational presence in Central India, particularly in cities within Madhya Pradesh. The company also actively explores growth opportunities within the B2B segment.
